name: Cleaarian Berry Farm
description: In WA, WA, Cleaarian Berry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples on a small apple orchard. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. The season runs through summer and autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from May – Jul in this growing zone.
